verdict.rationale: Cake explicitly claims capital-raise modeling that shows dilution impact, SAFE/Convertible Note raising, and a full contract editor that can be customised with an attorney, plus investor communication in one platform (cake-equity-docs-7, cake-equity-docs-6). However, there is no explicit mention of modeling an option pool top-up or producing a pro-forma ownership view distinct from dilution, and no direct evidence of a shareable 'scenario' artifact for counsel/investors beyond contract editing and e-signing. Missing for 10: option pool top-up modeling, explicit pro-forma ownership table output, and a dedicated scenario-sharing/export feature for counsel and investors.
